description: Hợp đồng UI/state đề xuất cho mockup, không phải trạng thái backend đã triển khai.

ride_quote_flow.rule: Only a valid, nonexpired, single acceptedQuoteId can become final amountPayable; price changes require explicit customer consent with new fareVersion.
ride_quote_flow.match: Driver cannot begin trip before passenger OTP verification; booking/offer states are backend-authoritative.

food_cod_flow.rule: COD cashCollected 150000 is liability/cash in hand; driverEarnings=20000 is separate, remaining 130000 is subject to reconciliation; backend ledger confirmation only.

role_switch: Switch visible shell/permissions only. Do not cancel active ride, driver job, or merchant queue automatically.
